adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in group-members.js.es6, the setupController method calls `model.findMembers()` without returning or awaiting the promise. This means if the AJAX request fails, the route transition will still complete successfully and render the template with potentially empty/stale data. The previous code in afterModel properly returned the promise, ensuring route transition waited for completion. This is a real behavioral change that could cause silent failures.
